newsitem.title: UK: Japan stocks nudge higher in thin London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japan stocks nudge higher in thin London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded in London edged higher on Friday but traders said business was muted. "It has been a very quiet day," said one trader at a Japanese bank in London. "The market is up a bit, but we have a holiday on Monday and most people seem to have gone home early."
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index gained 2.02 points, or 0.14 percent, and was at 1428.31 by 1354 GMT.
In Tokyo overnight, the key 225-issue Nikkei Average ended the session down 210.16 points, or 0.99 percent, at 21,112.24.
Markets in Japan will be closed on Monday for the Equinox national holiday.
